title: Log-Brunn–Minkowski conjecture
statement: Log-Brunn–Minkowski conjecture · 2012. For origin-symmetric convex bodies \(K,L\subset\mathbb R^n\) and \(0\le\lambda\le1\), it asserts \(V((1-\lambda)\cdot K+_0\lambda\cdot L)\ge V(K)^{1-\lambda}V(L)^\lambda\), where the log-sum is the Wulff body with support datum \(h_K^{1-\lambda}h_L^\lambda\) (original).

counterexample.description: Rational symmetric polytopes and rational \(\lambda\) reversing the inequality form a witness; a semialgebraic Wulff-body construction plus CAD/quantifier elimination or rigorous interval volume bounds certifies the strict gap.
